name: Fluent Bit Open Source Telemetry Collector
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source log, metric and trace collector/processor with configurable input, filter and output plugins, self-hosted without a software-imposed event or host quota.
watch_out: Fluent Bit is a telemetry pipeline component, not a free hosted monitoring dashboard or long-term log store. You provide runtime resources and downstream storage/analytics; external log destinations may charge for ingestion and retention.
